# teams_external_access_policy (Resource)

Manages the ExternalAccessPolicy policy via New-CsExternalAccessPolicy / Get-CsExternalAccessPolicy / Set-CsExternalAccessPolicy / Remove-CsExternalAccessPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `allowed_external_domains` (String) Maps to the -AllowedExternalDomains parameter.
- `blocked_external_domains` (String) Maps to the -BlockedExternalDomains parameter.
- `communication_with_external_orgs` (String) Maps to the -CommunicationWithExternalOrgs parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `enable_acs_federation_access` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableAcsFederationAccess parameter.
- `enable_federation_access` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableFederationAccess parameter.
- `enable_outside_access` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableOutsideAccess parameter.
- `enable_public_cloud_audio_video_access` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnablePublicCloudAudioVideoAccess parameter.
- `enable_teams_consumer_access` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableTeamsConsumerAccess parameter.
- `enable_teams_consumer_inbound` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableTeamsConsumerInbound parameter.
- `enable_teams_sms_access` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableTeamsSmsAccess parameter.
- `enable_xmpp_access` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableXmppAccess parameter.
- `federated_bilateral_chats` (Boolean) Maps to the -FederatedBilateralChats parameter.
- `restrict_teams_consumer_access_to_external_user_profiles` (Boolean) Maps to the -RestrictTeamsConsumerAccessToExternalUserProfiles parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
